First release of LocalPDF: offline PDF tools in the Windows Explorer and macOS Finder right-click menu.

Right-click a PDF to merge, compress, split, rotate, unlock or password-protect it, or convert it to Word, JPG, PNG or text. Right-click a photo, scan, Word, Excel or PowerPoint file to turn it into a PDF. Results land next to the original, which is never changed.

Everything is built in, including the Office converter: one installer, nothing else to download, and no internet needed. No uploads, no account, no telemetry.

### Download
- **Windows 10 / 11:** `LocalPDF_0.1.0_x64-setup.exe` (about 130 MB)
- **Mac with Apple Silicon (M1 and later):** `LocalPDF_0.1.0_aarch64.dmg` (about 190 MB)
- **Mac with Intel:** `LocalPDF_0.1.0_x64.dmg` (about 190 MB)

### First launch
These builds aren't code-signed yet, so your system will ask once:
- **Windows:** if SmartScreen says "Windows protected your PC", click **More info → Run anyway**.
- **Mac:** drag LocalPDF to Applications and open it. If macOS blocks it, go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**.

Then right-click any PDF. On Windows 11, LocalPDF is under **Show more options**; on a Mac, it's under **Quick Actions**.
